content.comment_body: Can you explain how you write to your PLC in my setup? Trying to send True to, for example, output Q1 does not seem to work.
Can you share how your node is configured? Select the node, export it (from the menu in the top right corner), and paste the configuration text here.

Hello, To toggle the PLC output ON or OFF, use the internal memory mapping. For example: V0.0 corresponds to Q1, V0.1 to Q2, V0.2 to Q3, and V0.3 to Q4. Assign DB1, BYTE 0 in your IoT system to set the desired output; the value determines which output is activated: DB1, BYTE 0 = 1 enables Q1, 2 for Q2, 4 for Q3, and 8 for Q4. Use your PLC's IP address and set Rack/Slot to 0/1.
Hi, Could you share a screenshot showing your variable configuration in Node-RED? I'm also finding it difficult to send data from Node-RED to the PLC outputs.
